desc:
The KLIK 22 is an ultra-compact rimfire suppressor engineered for shooters who want the smallest, lightest dedicated .22 can possible. The KLIK adds just over 1.8 inches of length to a standard ½-28 threaded barrel. It disappears on the muzzle, while delivering useful sound reduction.

Not too much to it. That’s the point.

The KLIK uses a system that vents like a compact muzzle device rather than a conventional sealed can. The result is very little added length, almost no extra mass, and a suppressor that stays cleaner than traditional rimfire baffles. It is purpose-built for rimfire rifles chambered in .22 LR, .22 WMR, and .17 HMR. It does significantly reduce muzzle signature on pistols; However, it is not hearing safe on a Traditional pistol. It is excellent with a barrel over 10” long.

Key Features

Mounting : Direct thread ½-28 only

Weight: At 1.5 oz (42.5 g)

Length: 2.25” overall, 1.8” added to a standard ½-28 threaded barrel

Material: 3D-printed Grade 5 (ELI) Titanium.

Caliber Compatibility: Optimized for .22 LR, .22 WMR, and .17 HMR. Best on rifles

Barrel Length Restriction: None for rated calibers

Rate of Fire: FRT and full auto rated for .22LR

Cleaning: Easy to soak or ultrasonic-clean. Titanium construction is compatible with common suppressor cleaning solutions. We recommend copper plated or polymer coated ammunition, this prevents excessive lead fouling.
